{{Top|leg}}
'''Holo-sensors''' or bio-sensors were [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] that were essential in the mapping of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] watery core and [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un's]] surface. They were primarily utilized by [[ER-1 probe droid]]s. The sensors mapped out any biological activity and sent back any positive finds to the probe droid. The readings were then analyzed by the probe droid and forwarded relevant information, sound through its [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and live holofeed through its [[remote sensor platform]], to a [[holoviewer]] or another [[Hologram/Legends|holographic device]]. They functioned in a similar fashion to [[Life-form scanner/Legends|lifeform scanners]].
